title: Tidal — full-page edge scene
source_role: Untouched original generated PNG copied into workspace
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original wide 16:9 background artwork for a minimalist personal website, an edge-to-edge full-page environment with a large reserved text area.
Scene: abstract shallow tidal water viewed from directly above. Large flowing tidal fronts and overlapping ripple curves sweep vertically through the RIGHTMOST 38 percent of the canvas, cut by both the right image boundary and the upper-right image boundary. Rich sage green and celadon water bands with deep dusty teal fine shadows and a few warm cream glints. Water feels broad and continuing beyond the page, never a small isolated puddle.
Composition: The LEFT 60 percent of the entire canvas MUST be completely clean, uniform almost-white paper color #F7F8F4, with NO artwork, NO texture, NO gradient, NO pattern, and NO green tint. The BOTTOM 12 percent across the entire canvas MUST likewise be clean uniform #F7F8F4 paper. Concentrate all strong color and visual detail at the top-right and mid-right. Near the middle-right boundary the water transitions into paper only through increasingly sparse, crisp printed marks with natural irregular edges, not a blur or an opacity fade. The water remains vivid where present. It can reach and be cropped through the top boundary only at the right edge of the canvas. Preserve at least 60 percent of the full canvas as wholly blank paper.
Style/medium: refined computational landscape and printed retro computer art. Fine visible terminal-glyph and ASCII-like halftone marks describe the flowing water curves, delicate orderly character matrices, small abstract glyphs treated solely as mark-making rather than readable text. Subtle tactile printed quality inside the colored water shapes only. A beautiful restrained mix of organic fluid forms and precise computer texture.
Constraints: full-width background composition, no separate picture panel, no border, no boxed image, no enclosed oval, no enclosed circular shape, no ellipse mask, no vignette, no gradual opacity wash, no blur, no overall green canvas, no text, no words, no typography, no logo, no UI, no watermark, no people, no objects, no clouds. Output exactly one 16:9 landscape image.
assessment: Strong water forms and visible ASCII halftone crop through top-right and right boundaries, with neutral paper left and below. No enclosing oval or box. The requested 60% full-height left clearance was not fully achieved: water/marks enter the upper image around 42% width; mid-page clearance is approximately 60%. Best used with copy kept in the left 40% at the top, or with the art horizontally positioned farther right during integration.
